body:
Founder real-time: 'keep working on self hosted parena compiler' -- closed the honest gap first flagged in the v0.88.0 Apple: selfhost/lexer.prn/parser.prn/region.prn/emit.prn had only ever been verified on this contributor's own dev box, never real CI. Linux (build_and_test job): all 4 selfhost domains now run via their own real make test-selfhost-* targets. Windows + macOS: 3 of 4 domains (lexer/parser/region) get a real, native link+run using each job's own already-set-up toolchain, compiling the already-committed tests/test_selfhost_*_gen.c directly -- no parena compiler binary needed on either runner. Domain 4 (emit.prn) deliberately NOT wired on Windows/macOS: its own real test shells out to gcc via system() to compile a further generated program, a genuinely different, harder-to-verify shape, honestly flagged as a real, separate, deferred follow-up rather than blindly wired. This CI wiring immediately paid for itself: found and fixed 2 real, confirmed-live Windows-only bugs no local verification could have caught (this contributor's own mingw cross-compile check uses a stub SDL2 header that doesn't replicate real SDL_main.h behavior). Bug 1: SDL_main.h's own real #define main SDL_main means int main(void) conflicts with the real declared int SDL_main(int argc, char *argv[]) the moment parena_runtime.h's unconditional <SDL2/SDL.h> include is reached on Windows -- fixed all 4 selfhost test files to the same real, working int main(int argc, char **argv) signature examples/editor_main.c itself already uses successfully. Bug 2: once that main-hijacking is active, the linker expects a real WinMain -- which SDL2main.a itself provides but only if actually linked -- fixed by linking the same real -lmingw32 -lSDL2main -lSDL2 -lSDL2_ttf recipe editor-demo's own build already uses (minus -mwindows, since these are CLI test tools meant to be read from stdout in the CI log). CI green on all 4 platform jobs after both fixes. 3 commits total (initial wiring + 2 real bug fixes), each caught by watching the actual CI run rather than assumed to work. PARENA commit 6fb3a5e, release v0.89.0.

⚓ ☃
title: v0.89.0: self-hosting test suite wired into real CI + 2 real Windows bugs found and fixed
